sentences.text: Shri Atul Gupta, learned counsel for the appellant.
Shri Sushant Tiwari, learned G.A. for respondent/State.

Heard on IA. No. 10247 of 2023, which is the fourth application under Section 389 (1) of Cr.P.C.
seeking suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of the appellant Arman Khan.

Appellant stood convicted under Section 376(i) of IPC and sentenced to undergo Life Imprisonment with fine of Rs.5000/-, under Section 323 of IPC and sentenced to undergo one year RI with fine of Rs.1000/-, under Section 3(2) (v) of S.C.S.T. Act and sentenced to undergo Life Imprisonment with a fine of Rs.5000/- , under Section 3(2) (v-a) of S.C. S.T. Act and sentenced to undergo one year R.I.
with a fine of Rs.1000/- and under Section 3(1) (s) of S.C. S.T. Act and sentenced to undergo one year RI with a fine of Rs.1000/- with default stipulations vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 20th August, 2018 passed by the Special Judge (SC/ST) Prevention of Atrocities, Act,
District-Vidisha in Special Sessions Case No.54/2018.

entities.text:
Special Judge (SC/ST) Prevention of Atrocities, Act,
District-Vidisha
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is the submission of learned counsel for appellant that trial Court erred in convicting the appellant and awarding jail sentence.

Learned counsel for appellant referred the course of events and medical examination of prosecutrix to bring home the fact that except some abrasion over her left wrist she did not suffer any physical violence.
Testimony of Dr. Leena Sharma (PW/10) and medical report (Ex-P/12) has been referred in this regard.

Learned counsel for appellant also referred the statement of defence witness Jahid (DW/1) who submits that some 7-8 months back because of monetary dispute shared by the parties, verbal and physical altercation ensued between them.
Therefore, according to appellant it is a case of false implication and trial Court ignored the same.
The appellant already suffered around five and half years of incarceration out of total ten years of jail sentence.
Fine amount has already been deposited.
Final hearing of appeal shall take some time.
Hence, prayer is made for suspension of sentence and grant of bail on behalf of the appellant.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent-State opposed the prayer on the basis of allegations and supported the impugned judgment passed by the trial Court.
Considering the submissions and the period of custody suffered by the appellant, this Court intends to allow the application for suspension of sentence (I.A.No.10247/2023).

If appellant -Arman Khan furnishes bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) along with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court that he shall appear before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 06.11.2023 and on all other subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Office for appearance, then he shall be released on bail and execution of jail sentence is suspended till disposal of this appeal.

Appellant shall not be a source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant party in any manner and shall not move in their vicinity, otherwise benefit of suspension of sentence shall immediately be withdrawn.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for information and necessary compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.

(ROHIT ARYA) (ANAND PATHAK)
 JUDGE JUDGE Van  VANDANA VERMA  2023.06.22  11:35:02 -07'00'
